prompt: The internet allows us to stay connected with each other no matter where we are. On the other hand, it also isolates us and encourages people not to socialise. To what extent do you agree or disagree with these statements.
essay:
Nowadays, the internet has become an important part of people’s lives. Some people believe that the internet allows people to communicate with others in different places, while others think that it can make people feel isolated and reduce face-to-face communication. I disagree with this opinion because the internet helps people make new friends and creates many opportunities.

To begin with, one of the main reasons why I disagree is that the internet helps people build and maintain relationships. People can easily communicate with their family and friends even if they live far away. For example, people who study or work in another country can use social media and video calls to stay in contact with their families. Moreover, they can meet new people through online groups and courses. As a result, the internet can help people develop stronger social relationships.

Moreover, the internet provides many opportunities for individuals. People can use it to study, find jobs, and learn new skills. For instance, someone can join an online course and develop useful skills for their future career. In addition, people can communicate with others who have similar interests and share their knowledge and experiences. Therefore, the internet can have a positive effect on both people’s social and professional lives.

In conclusion, although the internet can have some negative effects, I believe that its benefits are greater. It helps people stay connected with family and friends, build new relationships, and find valuable opportunities.
